scenes.line: Our businesses earned money. Then we checked where it went.

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: The snack audit suggested a spending freeze. Max had already started shopping.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Someone needed to run this house. I made the mistake of volunteering.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Dino responded with a pizza promise. Max stopped asking difficult questions.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Before choosing a leader, we needed a debate. And an explanation for dinner.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: The debate ended. We prepared a private household ballot. Max brought lunch.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: The ballots disappeared. We needed a voting method with less chewing.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: Objects proved unreliable. We asked the roommates to point at a leader.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Luna
scenes.line: Our own household chose the couch. Surely furniture could not make things worse.
scenes.beat: WEEK FOUR / WHO RUNS THE HOUSE?

scenes.speaker: Zig
scenes.line: The couch is in charge. What should happen next: a house holiday, or a new roommate? Tell us your choice.
